name: SmolPng
description: Minimal one-pass 1-bit PNG decoder ported from smol-epub png.rs. Parses PNG chunks + uzlib deflate + scanline filter inversion + RGB-to-luma + Floyd-Steinberg dither, emitting 1-bit BMP directly. Mirrors the SmolJpeg pattern: no intermediate full-image grayscale buffer. Phase 6 of the snapix v3 refactor; activates under SNAPIX_SMOL_PNG.
